event_name: Time 16:13 2020 RUSSIAN GRAND PRIX 24 - 27 September 2020 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged failure to follow Race Director's Instruction in turn 2.
offence: Alleged breach of the FIA International Sporting Code Article 12.1.1 (i), failure to follow the instructions contained in the Event Notes (v3) item 22.
reason: The Stewards reviewed video evidence. Car 8 left the track at turn 2 failed to follow the RD's instruction as defined in the event notes 22.1 but in this case the situation resulted from a racing incident due to the proximity of car 5 and the driver did all he could to follow the race directors instruction the Stewards decide on no further action
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 8 Turn 2
to: The Team Manager, Haas F1 Team
